what_happened: Task description's claim that --emit-inventory preserves every trailing description byte-for-byte is refuted for the RaySummary table: split_row splits on raw '|' so the three rows containing escaped '\|' (HitComplete, AnchorLayer, LadderModel) are truncated to their last fragment on regeneration (scratch-copy run). The description also says six modules; the directory now holds 16.

Drift already recurred: the 2026-10-13 hand reconcile of RaySummary/README.md (3211dd7af) wrote 406/578/1624 for AnchorLayer/Profile/Periodic while the files at that same commit were 418/581/1627; INV was green throughout. Tree sweep: 29 of ~33 unwrapped Lines-bearing inventory tables under FormalSystem/ are stale right now.

Extracting the generator's embedded Python verbatim and overriding only its target loop via an env var gave a faithful scratch-copy dry run of --emit-inventory (check -> write -> re-check) without touching the tree; a one-line escape-aware re.split in split_row was verified to preserve all 16 RaySummary descriptions byte-for-byte.

Research report Tier A lists Metalogic/Expressiveness/README.md and Metalogic/WeakCanonical/README.md as clean fits, but both carry subdirectory rows with numeric line totals (e.g. EFGames/ 11,800) that the default cols=lines column set renders as an em-dash placeholder; wrapping them as-is would drop those totals. Plan demotes both to the report-only Tier B bucket (option cols=files-lines would need a header rewrite and the '(N files)' phrases in descriptions re-authored).

Research report arrived with a machine-checked scratch simulation, a three-tier sweep, and a settled user decision on the escaped-pipe split, so planning needed no new investigation beyond re-deriving table anchors and spot-checking two Tier-A candidates; plan validated clean on first pass.
